canonical_project: DC Alliance / Pacific Blockchain Tier III data centre proposal (site unnamed)
owner: DC Alliance Pte Ltd (Figtree Holdings 27.5% associate) with Pacific Blockchain Corporation
notes: Only public commercial datacenter proposal for Palau: non-binding 12-month MOU signed 10 Feb 2022 between DC Alliance and Palau-based Pacific Blockchain Corporation to explore a Tier III data centre; proposal capacity 1 MW / up to 200 racks initially, potential 5 MW / up to 1,000 racks (SGX filing = A for MOU terms). No site named in the MOU; assigned to Koror as likely business-centre location per methodology - UNVERIFIED. No construction/operation follow-up found through 2026-08-12; keep status announced (stale MOU) - do NOT upgrade to planned/construction.
